item.description:
1.1.26 — One flat window

  • Nothing in the way. The window, sidebar and page are one plain sheet, with a fine line between the sidebar and the page.
  • The page fills the window. No toolbar above it: back, forward and reload sit next to the window buttons, and ⌘L drops the address bar from the top.
  • Calmer details. Flat grey selection, smaller pinned tiles, and a plain loading line.

1.1.25 — Lighter type

  • Quieter type. Text and icons are a step lighter everywhere, in plain system type.
  • Tabs that read at a glance. The tab you're on is in ink; the rest sit back in grey.
  • A simpler sidebar. The space name is smaller, so your tabs come first.

1.1.24 — A quieter look

  • Graphite and paper. Pane drops its colors for clean whites, soft greys and ink — in light and dark.
  • Glows made of light. Instead of a rainbow, a single arc of light travels around the edge of what you're typing in, like daylight catching a pane of glass.
  • A lit selection. The tab you're on sits in a soft grey pill with a fine highlight along its top edge.
  • A calmer New Tab page. A soft pool of light from above, and nothing else in the way.
